name: MSI Mystic Light (0DB0)
description: Direct mode of MSI Mystic Light motherboard RGB controllers that enumerate as 0DB0:0076 (OpenRGB's "MSI Mystic Light Common" and "X870" detectors), adapted from OpenRGB's MSIMotherboardController: the board is looked up by the first four hex digits of the USB serial number (for example 7E12, MAG X670E TOMAHAWK WIFI). Same protocol code as msi-mystic-light: the configuration read at start is written back on exit and the save-to-flash byte is set only by "Save to devices" (SaveToDevice, after the user confirmed it; 185- and 162-byte boards). Protocol notes: docs/hardware/msi-mystic-light.md.
